name: transition_selected_object_scale

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_TransitionSelectedObjectScale consumes four values, divides the three scale components by 100, packs the duration into a type-0x1E object operation, and decrements Script stackTop by four

notes: The embedded object-operation table labels type 0x1E SCALE. The operation targets the Script-selected object and carries independent normalized X, Y, and Z scale factors plus a duration. The JP corpus contains 83 calls; zero-duration calls apply an immediate scale, while nonzero durations include 1, 16, and 90 ticks.
